headline: Klopp not preparing for more titles after verdict against Man City
description: Jürgen Klopp said Wednesday he would "wait and see" before commenting on the Premier League's announcement yesterday that Manchester City had been found guilty of 114 charges for breaching financial rules.

headline: UK PM Burnham 'concerned' Man City's owners could sell club
description: The UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he "would be really concerned" if Manchester City 's owners sell the club following the guilty verdict for breaching Premier League financial rules.
